title: Imps
summary: Familiars, messengers, and crooked little teachers.
pages: An Imp should not be mistaken for a quest marker with horns. It knows pieces of the road and offers them in the language of familiars: warnings, riddles, favors, and half-explanations.
What an Imp teaches can become writing in the Book of Shadows, but the Book records the lesson; it does not replace the teacher.
